messages:
Erin: Heads-up PRD intake — FinCo saw recurring p95 spikes on Dedicated during US mornings. Problem statement: cold-capacity growth and burst patterns cause tenant p95 to hit 2-3x baseline and violates their SLA.
Alice: can you scope this? is this a runtime rewrite or config/workflow change?
Erin: keep it small. Deliverable = per-tenant SLA fallback policy + checklist, runbook, and pilot on 2 tenants. No runtime kernel work.
Ben: OK on fallback as a routing policy. Need concrete thresholds and expected behavior when triggered.
Erin: Target: tenant.p95 <= 350ms. Trigger if p95 > 350ms for 3 consecutive minutes. Allowed fallback may increase p95 up to +30% vs baseline but must reduce tail volatility.
Carla: acceptance criteria draft:
- tenant.p95 <= 350ms for 95% of rolling 1h windows after rollout
- If trigger fires, route affected requests to compatible quantized model variant preserving API semantics
- 5xx attributable to fallback <= 0.1%
- Rollback automated if eval harness shows semantic regression within 24h
Ben: policy example (pseudo): {"trigger": {"metric": "tenant.p95","window": "3m","threshold_ms": 350}, "action": {"route_to": "model-v1-quantized","reason": "sla-fallback"}}
Carla: edge-cases: batching interactions during cold starts, tenant custom routing rules, quota enforcement if fallback increases token use, and model-variant semantic drift — we need eval prompts.
Alice: I'll need a tenant-level histogram metric and a small synthetic eval set. Also need model-variant artifact tags from model onboarding.
Gabe: deps: routing policy UI change, per-tenant metric groups, eval harness jobs, canary toggle in Console. Owners?
Erin: Owner: Carla (spec + runbook). Ben (rollout automation). Alice (metrics + alerts). Timeline: EOW agree scope, 2-week spike prototyping, pilot in 4 weeks.
Ben: rollout plan: gradual ramp 0.1% -> 1% -> 10% over 6h, monitor p95/5xx/semantic drift, auto-stop on breach. Limit fallback duration per tenant per hour as a safety.
Carla: add acceptance test: run workload against baseline and fallback and require embedding cosine >= 0.95 on eval prompts.
Gabe: risk — fallback could increase token spend. Mitigation: budget guardrail and limit total fallback time. If we can't track cost well, add cost instrumentation to non-goals but note risk.
Alice: I'll provision metrics + synth eval by Wed EOD. Ben will prototype policy mapping this week. Carla will draft PRD first pass Wed afternoon.
product-bot: Calendar invite created: PRD review 0 tenants SLA fallback0 Thu 11:00 — attendees: erin, carla, ben, alice, gabe :calendar: 
Erin: thanks — please flag missing acceptance conditions here, especially around failure budget and cost accounting. :thumbsup:
